name: GLab Enterprise
description: GLab Enterprise is an independent technology and engineering enterprise exploring practical software, digital products and technical solutions, guided by thoughtful innovation and a commitment to supporting and protecting the natural environment.

intro: GLab Enterprise (GLab Ent.) is an independent technology and engineering enterprise exploring practical software, digital products and technical solutions. Its work spans software development, network and infrastructure systems, automation and security-aware tools.

Nature, Technology and Innovation guide how GLab thinks, learns and builds. As the enterprise grows, it aims to support, conserve and protect nature through responsible practices, practical contributions within its means, and thoughtful use of technology. GLab distinguishes its principles and intentions from activities and outcomes that have actually been completed.
profile.statement: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

interests.title: Nature & Environmental Responsibility
interests.description: Understanding natural systems, favouring repair and reuse where practical, reducing avoidable waste, and supporting credible conservation efforts as capacity allows.

interests.title: Software & Systems Engineering
interests.description: Practical web applications, operational software, maintainable systems, data workflows and automation.

interests.title: Networks & Infrastructure
interests.description: ISP operations, broadband systems, network monitoring, GIS, fibre planning and infrastructure documentation.

interests.title: Cybersecurity & Digital Resilience
interests.description: Authorised diagnostics, least-privilege access, privacy-aware development, secure operations, Linux systems and practical safeguards.

interests.title: Research & Emerging Technology
interests.description: Exploring AI, machine learning, measurement, data systems and technical ideas with evidence-led evaluation.

interests.title: Community & Digital Preservation
interests.description: Building and maintaining useful digital resources while respecting provenance, attribution and community context.
